theorems.name: Submission.dtc_hausdorff_dilation
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (x : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → (∀ s : Set (Euclid P), μHE[n] (dilation x lam '' s) = ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ n) * μHE[n] s) ∧ Measure.map (dilation x lam) (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclid P)) = ENNReal.ofReal (lam ^ n) • (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclid P))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
